value.answer: Sounds like a common cold - very normal at this age, kids can get several a year. Since she's active and eating well, no treatment needed beyond comfort care (saline drops, fluids, help with nose-blowing).
value.triage: Call 811 if symptoms last more than 7-10 days without improving, she develops a fever, stops eating/drinking, or seems more unwell. Go to the ER or call 911 now for fast/laboured breathing, ribs pulling in, grunting, or blue lips.
